# MYRIAD sanitized distribution

This directory is the public-facing data subset of MYRIAD.

It contains all 10,000 task nodes with normalized routing, task, safety, no-call, and maturity fields. Internal legacy reports and normalization provenance are omitted. The original scientific task titles and objectives are preserved.

The records validate against `myriad-task-sanitized.schema.json` and remain taxonomy nodes and require task-specific implementation, current primary-source resolution, and qualified review before operational use.
